fieldValues.title: Gate: an affirmed problem must be grounded in an affirmed domain
fieldValues.decision_question: What must an affirmed problem satisfy, and how strict is the check?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Severity: (a) warn now, then error for problems affirmed on or after the gate's merge date (the BOUNDARY_RULES_FROM pattern); (b) warn everywhere until both domains are walked, then error everywhere; (c) error now, which fails all 47 affirmed problems. Shared persona: required to be affirmed, or not required now.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Clerk check-method requires an affirmed problem to be held-by at least one affirmed persona-in-domain whose in-domain edge (exactly one) reaches an affirmed domain record. Ends resolve via derived-from using JS canon(), a duplicate of srs-web canon that moves to core when the process settles. Severity (b): warn everywhere until both domains are walked, then error everywhere. The shared persona need not be affirmed. Open item: before the flip the other 27 affirmed problems (the other 3 domains) must be grounded or set aside, or the flip is scoped.
fieldValues.rationale: Warning first lets the walk finish without blocking the other domains.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When personas weight priority (the shared persona may then need to be affirmed); and before the flip to error.
